featured_reviews.name: Sai Kumar Minajagi
featured_reviews.review_text:
My passport is issued in Bangalore so I travelled here & applied by self & got 30days single entry tourist visa. No need of any appointments. Just walk-in with the online filled application you are let inside based on first-come-first-serve basis.

For any help you can reach out to me.

1. Google maps mentions that Visa office opens at 9am, but nope!! it opens at 8am exact.

2. People start queuing on the street from 7am only. The security will start letting you in from 8am.

3. There will be two queues one for self applicants & other for agents. Few people from both the queues are let inside at a time.

4. Located on 8th floor. Once you reach there strict security check is done.

5. You’ll be given a token number & asked to wait in waiting hall. Once the number appears on screen you’ll go to respective counter & submit the docs.

6. There are plenty of counters & waiting there won’t be of much time.

7. Once the documents are accepted & cash payment is done you’ll be given pickup form mentioning the expected collection date of passport.

8. No fingerprints are collected for tourist visa.

9. Even during peak hours the total time spent here would be maximum 30mins.

Overall it was good experience. You can reach here on cheap option by using double-decker bus that start from outside of CST station.

featured_reviews.review_text:
I am extremely disappointed with the services at the Visa Application Center for China in Mumbai, specifically the preliminary document verification stage—not the interview process.

The system feels outdated and highly inefficient, with significant delays in processing applications. This becomes especially stressful for applicants with imminent travel dates.

It is also extremely difficult to get in touch with the office. Their phone lines are nearly impossible to connect—you may need to call dozens of times before getting through. When connected, responses are often unhelpful, with repeated assurances of callbacks that never happen.

Due to these delays and lack of communication, we were forced to reschedule flights, incurring additional costs. Hotel bookings and itineraries had to be revised multiple times, causing considerable inconvenience and stress. Even after all these efforts, there was no clear update on the application status.

After posting a review, we were asked to connect via other channels and share our application details. However, after providing the application number, the status was updated to “unapproved” without any explanation, which raises serious concerns about transparency in the process.

Overall, the experience reflects poor communication, lack of accountability, and an urgent need for system and service improvements.
